The browser demo serves the Pyodide 314.0.8 core runtime from this directory so it can start without contacting a separate CDN. The runtime files are unchanged copies from the [official Pyodide release distribution](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/pyodide/v314.0.8/full/). The upstream source is available at [pyodide/pyodide, tag 314.0.8](https://github.com/pyodide/pyodide/tree/314.0.8). The Pyodide and Python licenses accompany the runtime. The desk runs entirely on fictional records in the browser's worker. Browser microphone recognition, when available and enabled by the caller, uses the browser's own speech service.
